clips.title: The story
paras: The Falfarren River cuts through central Ashenvale, from Mount Hyjal toward the northern mountains of the Barrens. Its banks mark the divide between night elven lands and Horde outposts, where travelers face wild dangers and open conflict.

The Falfarren River descends from Mount Hyjal, spilling over waterfalls into Xavian before winding between Splintertree Post and Night Run. In ordinary weather, its waters are neither especially deep nor impassable. The river marks a rough boundary through central Ashenvale. Astranaar and the heart of the Kaldorei lands lie west; Horde camps and lumber operations lie east. The wooden bridges on the main road carry travelers into the contested forest, where patrols clash along the banks.

The Falfarren River holds dangers beyond clashes between sentinels and grunts. Near Felfire Hill, corrupted bog beasts and aggressive water creatures prowl the muddy shallows. Rain can swell the currents. Dense canopies line both shores, where ambushes and skirmishes often spill into the stream.
